en.title: Inside a Chinese UAV Showcase: Cargo, Surveying & VTOL Aircraft from Wuhu Tianxun
en.summary: A look at a range of UAV platforms presented by Wuhu Tianxun, including aircraft for surveying, inspection, cargo transport and vertical takeoff and landing. Watch the full showcase video.
en.content:
China continues to expand its industrial UAV lineup. In this showcase we walk through a range of platforms presented by Wuhu Tianxun — covering surveying and inspection, cargo transport, and vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) designs.

The video highlights practical configurations for real-world missions: mapping and inspection aircraft, cargo platforms built for logistics, and VTOL systems that combine vertical takeoff flexibility with efficient cruise performance.

These platforms reflect broader trends in the Chinese UAV industry — specialization by mission type, increasing payload and endurance options, and designs aimed at industrial rather than consumer use.
